readings: Implement radix-4 Booth recoding: examine overlapping 3-bit groups, handle +2/+1/0/-1/-2, shift by 2, and complete in about 8 cycles.
Implement exactly as described: test multiplier[ctr] one bit per cycle, add multiplicand when 1, shift multiplicand left by 1, run for 16 cycles, and never subtract.
Respect the port roles: multiplier register <= sign-extended b, multiplicand register <= sign-extended a.
Follow the reset text literally: multiplier register <= sign-extended a, multiplicand register <= sign-extended b, swapping the roles of a and b.
Reset is asynchronous and sets only multiplier and multiplicand; p, ctr, and rdy keep previous or unknown values, so the first product and rdy depend on power-up or prior state.
Reset should also clear p=0, ctr=0, rdy=0, and may be synchronous or asynchronous depending on the intended sensitivity list, making the first multiplication deterministic.

ambiguities.aspect: p accumulation ordering and shift timing
readings: Left-shift multiplicand first in the same clock, then add the newly shifted value to p.
Because nonblocking assignments update together, add the old pre-shift multiplicand value to p; shift and add may occur in separate cycles.
